PURE SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF glyphs on perfectly clean PURE BLACK #000000. Match the reference's broad sober stencil silhouettes and restrained large black negative-space cuts. Keep every complete subject in the middle 60% of its cell with at least 20% blank margin on ALL FOUR sides. No mark or body part may cross cell boundaries. All heads, wrists, fingers, tool handles, vehicles and barrels remain complete. These must read at 16/24/32 px: simplify details rather than draw a miniature illustration. NO grey shading, gradients, hatching, dithering, distressed edges, speckles, thin wrinkles, hair strands, readable text, initials, numerals, logos, borders or watermark.
